query.en: Create a social media poster, vertical 1080×1350 (4:5). The content is the Open Design Agent Kit — ‘One agent. Every canvas.’ Dark technical aesthetic: near-black background with a faint 48px grid that fades out via a radial mask, plus soft lime and cyan radial glows. Top: a mono lime eyebrow ‘Open Design Agent Kit’ with a glowing dot, a ~92px serif headline ‘One agent. Every canvas.’ with ‘canvas’ italic in cyan, and a muted subhead: your coding agent designs it, then ships it to Figma, Canva and every social feed — through connectors, not copy-paste. Center: an animated SVG orbit diagram — a glowing ‘Coding Agent + OPEN DESIGN AGENT KIT’ core node at the center, an inner dashed orbit with Figma and Canva nodes in lime, an outer dashed orbit with X, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube and Xiaohongshu nodes in cyan, and dashed connector lines flowing from the core to every node with a soft glow underlay (disable all animation under prefers-reduced-motion). Footer: three value points with mono cyan labels — 01 · PULL: turn Figma frames into working pages; 02 · PUSH: send finished artifacts to Canva; 03 · POST: export sized for every social feed — and, on the right, the ‘open-design agent kit’ lockup plus a crisp inline-SVG QR code linking to the repo. Lime #BBF351 and cyan #00BCFF only; Roboto + STIX Two Text + Source Code Pro; stroke-only inline-SVG glyphs, no photos, no emoji.
